cohort: A total of 48 patients who underwent endoscopic evaluation for food allergy before initiating oral immunotherapy (OIT).
finding: Patients with a combination of any three fetal and infant period risk factors (maternal fever, cesarean delivery, formula feeding, antibiotic use, and neonatal intensive care admission) had an approximately five times increased risk of esophageal eosinophilia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as one of the early life risk factors that, when combined with others, significantly increased the risk of esophageal eosinophilia.
